title: The Weekly Challenge - 398
task1_desc: You are given an array of positive integers. Write a script to return the closest integer to the mean value of all even integers that are divisible by 3. If none is divisible, return 0.
task2_desc: You are given an array of equal length strings. Write a script to find the difference integer array of each word in the given array. There will be one word with a different array; return that word.
